arguments.question: Using only the supplied retained evidence (baseline summary and the controller-observations file), what evidence-based explanations account for the secondary-performance failures of candidate proposal_compliant_build: sampled_settling_passed = false (late_max_speed_m_s ≈ 1.58 m/s and late_max_error_m ≈ 0.058 m against the position_limit_m = 0.01 m / speed_limit_m_s = 0.02 m/s / window_s = 0.05 s settling criteria) while reach_passed = true (terminal_error_m ≈ 0.0076 m within tolerance), and separately 35 of 35 control updates missing the 0.01 s deadline (mean_update_s ≈ 17.1 s, controller_boundary_wall_s ≈ 29.55 s, stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop = 34 of 35)? Which candidate explanations are supported, weakened, or left unresolved by the exact selectors, and what single bounded saved-state check would best discriminate among the remaining explanations without assuming any cause? Note explicitly that reach, sampled settling and real-time feasibility are separate outcomes and are not to be conflated.
scope: (1) Retained-evidence reading only: the supplied binding, evidence manifest, baseline summary and the controller-observations file (b59be99a8308a48d4b44c69af4296d51c3b13241679c4b7a6c22ee601d69f770), read-only and without any new execution.

(2) One bounded numerical saved-state check under the supplied saved_state_check grant (model.gvs@1.0.0, horizon_s 0.01, integration implicit_euler, integration_step_s 0.002, max_checks 1, max_wall_s 300, numerical_limits local_solves 6 / prediction_evaluations 24, operations prediction_braking and local_comparison), executed against the identified execution saved state or a temporary analysis configuration only. Any local_comparison is bounded analysis and does not by itself authorize later adoption; if a comparison is proposed it is provisional and adoption of the exact parameter/value would require a separate matched design adoption.

(3) Excluded: production controller changes/tuning, modification of production or baseline, full backend simulation or backend execution, and worker calls. The probe must never modify production or baseline.
stopping_conditions: Stop the initial report once exact selected facts, hypotheses and evidence gaps for the sampled-settling failure and the deadline misses have been separated with exact evidence references and JSON Pointer selectors.
Stop the bounded saved-state check after exactly one check (max_checks = 1), or at 300 s wall, or at 6 local_solves / 24 prediction_evaluations, whichever occurs first.
Stop if the request would require production controller changes, a full backend simulation, or any modification of production or baseline; those are out of scope.
Stop and report unresolved if the retained evidence cannot discriminate among candidate explanations without a new numerical grant.
